speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng
text: asked the Minister for Health (a) what are the plans to improve information sharing and integration of processes between the three healthcare clusters to enhance patient experience; and (b) whether the Ministry is exploring the use of a single mobile app for the different healthcare systems so that patients and caregivers need not use multiple apps.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
text: These common services are also made available through the clusters' apps.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
text: This reduces duplication of development effort and facilitates consistent user experience, regardless of the platform a person prefers to use to connect with our healthcare system.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
text: Meanwhile, the presence of healthcare cluster-specific apps enables those healthcare providers to customise features tailored to their specific facilities and services, and also to innovate on user-interaction features that could better engage their patients.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
text: Over time, some of these new innovations that are well-received and successful in engaging patients can be incorporated as common services that are then made available to all patients in their preferred platform, be it HealthHub or one of the cluster apps.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
text: We will continue to improve our digital services and enhance our offerings to improve the user experience.

speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng (Yio Chu Kang)
text: This is to make it more convenient for residents as they have only to use one app to interface with Government, as opposed to having to download many different apps to interface with the Government.

speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
text: LifeSG is one of those that aggregates a number of services.

speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
text: So, where it works for the patient experience – maybe for safety, for information gathering, or for user experience – we will always be considering how to optimise and streamline.

speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
text: The nature of many of the products' platforms that the Member refers to, is that they are the front-end for common core services.

speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
text: The backbone is common, the data standards are common, the information sharing processes are common.

speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
text: But then, engaging with a particular provider allows a user experience, as well as facilities specific services to then be deployed.

speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
text: The example that the Member gave with LifeSG is salient to this because in LifeSG, many of those functions are also accessible through other means, where it is appropriate for either the provider or for the citizen.

speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
text: We will continue to review the entire space.
